Latios

Dragon Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3 · Legendary Pokémon

Latios is a Dragon/Psychic-type Eon Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2 m tall and weighs 60 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (130), with a base stat total of 600.
